rationale: Hrushikesh brings deep healthcare operations and supply chain expertise from Sharp Healthcare, while Zee is building Clara, a YC-backed AI doctor startup that will need to navigate complex healthcare delivery and operational logistics. Their complementary backgrounds—one grounded in healthcare systems, the other in AI product design—create a natural opportunity to discuss how AI tools can integrate into real-world clinical and supply chain workflows.
intro_message: Hrushikesh, meet Zee — she's co-founding Clara, a YC S26 AI doctor startup, and your supply chain expertise at Sharp Healthcare could offer valuable perspective on how AI healthcare tools get operationalized in real health systems.
